secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Google OAuth client ID used for shopper sign-in. Create an OAuth client (Web application) in Google Cloud Console -> APIs & Services -> Credentials, then add the sandbox callback URL as an authorised redirect URI.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: Secret paired with GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, from the same Google Cloud Console OAuth client.

secrets.name: SESSION_SECRET
secrets.description: Signing key for the signed sign-in cookie.
